title: The How the Crack Got in the Step
youtube_title: The How the Crack Got in the Step | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Waiting your turn to talk lets someone feel heard.
summary: At a cottage hearth with the clock unhurried, Auntie June begins to tell Bodhi about how the crack got in the step, which was a longer story than the crack. Bodhi wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
